name: Craftable Blackstone
summary: Makes blackstone craftable from basalt and coal, so it can be obtained without finding it in the Nether.

vanilla_changes.change: 2x2 with basalt on one diagonal and coal or charcoal on the other -> 4 blackstone.
Same 2x2 diagonal layout with polished basalt + coal or charcoal -> 4 polished blackstone.

getting_started: Craft in a normal crafting table (or furnace where noted); recipes appear in the recipe book once the ingredients are held.
editor_notes: Part of the bundled VanillaTweaks Crafting Tweaks datapack (version 26.2 selection). Recipes are server-side; the datapack is loaded via Paxi.
